admission: Finite registered parameters and strict continuation-only log-distance .005..6e-1; boundary denominator/flow and final finite-value/tangent checks; CDF argument abs<=12. No clipping or default extension. A/B poles are removed by integral identities; no reset interpolation map exists in this component.
debt_semantics: One newly issued debt-unit value d(V,m) at maturity tau=m; not aggregate stationary debt integral D(V)=integral_0^m d(V,tau)dtau. The maturity column changes both stationary parameters/unitization and evaluation horizon; no independent tau coordinate.
excluded_branches: No asset-coordinate or asset-default API, no x=0 boundary derivative, no Taylor/blend or min-limit tie derivatives, no FP32/mixed precision qualification. Since R11 blend limit<=.002, every admitted state is strictly in the raw continuation branch.
finite_difference: Central or domain-inward three-point slopes at h,h/2,h/4, two adjacent Richardson extrapolates for all five channels/all ten coordinates; no error-based step repair.
formal_roster: 64 fresh fixed seeded nine-parameter interior draws, each at three fixed log-distances, plus old baseline at the same three states;195 numeric points. Not195 independent task worlds or all-corner coverage.
jacobian_columns: Nine physical coordinates in the above order, then independent log-distance state; five output rows
native_numeric_primitives: Linux host libm erfc supplies scalar CDF value; exact Gaussian pdf supplies its mathematical first tangent. A and B divided differences are evaluated by smooth derivative integrals at16 Gauss-Legendre points. CDF intervals use a positive Gaussian integral. This is FP64 mathematical AD, not a derivative of machine rounding.
output_reservation: Allocate RAW extents before generating the new roster; final gzip must fit the reserved8MiB, overwrites allocated extents and truncates. This reduces observed ENOSPC outcome-loss risk; no arbitrary I/O failure, SIGKILL or power-loss recovery guarantee.
physical_jacobian_semantics: Physical partials at fixed log-distance, not fixed asset. For continuation asset V=b*exp(x), f_theta|V=f_theta|x-f_x*b_theta/b and f_V=f_x/V; these are explanatory chain identities, not a newly admitted asset API.
reference: Unchanged R11 kernel snapshot with explicitly remapped parameter/Jacobian order; independent80-digit direct erfc/B/A quotients with mp.diff for every value and derivative; selected separate Volterra-ODE equity/Laplace-boundary audit.
